test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follows from the statement.

**Statement:**

The patient who was brought to the emergency during the last night would have survived if the surgery was done sometime before.

**Conclusions:**

I. Surgery was the only option for survival.

II. Patient was brought to the hospital late.

options.text: Neither I nor II conclusion follows
Both I and II conclusion follow

solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given statements:

The patient who was brought to the emergency during the last night would have survived if the surgery was done sometime before → The statement is talking about the past event which already has happened. It talks about the patient who was brought to the emergency during the last night would have survived if the surgery was done sometime before.

Conclusions:

I. Surgery was the only option for survival → Follows (as according to the given statement if the surgery wa done sometime before, he would have survived, therefore surgery was the only option)

II. Patient was brought to the hospital late → Not Follows (as according to the given statement he would have survived if the surgery was done sometime before therefore patient was not brought to the hospital late but the surgery was done late)

Hence, **Only conclusion I follows.**
